replies.author: Pavlo
replies.body:
I really disagree with this suggestion. My reasoning for this is that with the amount if donators in chat, every second or third sentence will be flourishing with colors making everything look messy.

However I do believe that donors should get a colored nickname. I've seen these on other servers and it works very nicely. It's a nice and fancy perk, but it doesn't make the chat messy. 

There is however a group of people I believe should get colored chat. This is staff. I say this because there are far fewer staff than donors, so it would look a heck of a lot less messy. But more importantly, staffs messages need to be seen by players, and the best way to do this is with colored chat.
